analogy.rationale: SIRT1 is a nuclear deacetylase whose inhibition alters chromatin acetylation and stress/metabolic transcriptional programs, overlapping most with other epigenetic modifiers (HDAC and histone methyltransferase inhibitors) and, more weakly, with DNA methylation and metabolic-sensing pathways; because SIRT1 is broadly expressed, some measurable but modest response is expected.
